# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `make docs` (go run ./cmd/gen-tool-docs) from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

crunch-mcp has **70 tools** in **9 toolsets**: 36 read, 24 write, 9 delete and 1 email. It also has **6 prompts**.

Each tool is labelled with the setting it needs:

| Label | Registered when |
|---|---|
| 🟢 read | Always |
| 🟠 write | `CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES=true` |
| 🔴 delete | `CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES=true` and `CRUNCH_ALLOW_DELETES=true` |
| 🟣 email | `CRUNCH_ALLOW_WRITES=true` and `CRUNCH_ALLOW_EMAIL=true` |

Every tool also needs its toolset to be enabled in `CRUNCH_TOOLSETS`, which enables all toolsets by default. List tools return compact summaries and take `raw: true` for the full API objects. Amounts can be given as numbers (`120`) or decimal strings (`"120.00"`), and dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Contents

- [`account`](#account): Login status and the OAuth login flow, the logged-in user, company details (VAT number and scheme, addresses) and a one-call business overview.
- [`reference`](#reference): Lookups for the values Crunch expects: expense types, VAT types, payment methods, countries, open accounting periods, and directors and employees.
- [`banking`](#banking): Bank accounts and credit cards: balances, details, payments recorded against them, opening balances, default accounts, archiving.
- [`clients`](#clients): Clients (the customers you invoice): list, look up, create, update and delete.
- [`suppliers`](#suppliers): Suppliers (who you buy from): list, look up, create, update, archive and delete.
- [`expenses`](#expenses): Expenses: list and filter, totals, create with lines, payments and receipts, update, record and remove payments, attach and download receipts, delete.
- [`recurring`](#recurring): Recurring expenses that Crunch creates on a schedule: list, create, pause or change, delete.
- [`invoices`](#invoices): Sales invoices: list and filter, totals, create drafts, update, issue, email to the customer, record and remove payments, attachments, PDF download, delete.
- [`raw`](#raw): A raw API escape hatch for anything the other tools don't cover. It is limited to GET requests unless writes are enabled.
- [Prompts](#prompts)

## account

Login status and the OAuth login flow, the logged-in user, company details (VAT number and scheme, addresses) and a one-call business overview.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_auth_complete`](#crunch_auth_complete) | 🟢 read | Finish Crunch login |
| [`crunch_auth_start`](#crunch_auth_start) | 🟢 read | Start Crunch login |
| [`crunch_auth_status`](#crunch_auth_status) | 🟢 read | Crunch login status |
| [`crunch_get_company_details`](#crunch_get_company_details) | 🟢 read | Get company details |
| [`crunch_get_overview`](#crunch_get_overview) | 🟢 read | Business overview |
| [`crunch_get_user_details`](#crunch_get_user_details) | 🟢 read | Get user details |

### crunch_auth_complete

🟢 read

Finish a login started with crunch_auth_start by exchanging the authorisation code for tokens, which are saved to the token file. Pass the full URL the browser was redirected to (or just the code).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `redirected_url` | string | yes | The full URL from the browser's address bar after clicking Allow (it contains code= and state=), or just the code |

### crunch_auth_start

🟢 read

Start logging this server in to a Crunch account (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE). Returns a URL for the user to open and approve. After they click Allow, the browser is sent to the redirect URI; if nothing is listening there the page fails to load, which is fine: ask the user to copy the full URL from the address bar and pass it to crunch_auth_complete. Logging in replaces the current tokens, possibly with a different Crunch account.

_No arguments._

### crunch_auth_status

🟢 read

Show whether this server is logged in to Crunch: where the tokens come from, the granted scopes, when the access token expires and whether a refresh token is available. Never shows the tokens themselves.

_No arguments._

### crunch_get_company_details

🟢 read

Get the business's details from Crunch: company name and number, VAT registration number, current VAT scheme (for example flat rate, with industry and limited cost trader status), and business and registered addresses.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |

### crunch_get_overview

🟢 read

A one-call snapshot of the business: company and VAT details, bank account and credit card balances, sales invoice totals (invoiced and outstanding) and open accounting periods. A good first call for questions like "how is my business doing?".

_No arguments._

### crunch_get_user_details

🟢 read

Get the logged-in Crunch user: ID, email address, first and last name.

_No arguments._

## reference

Lookups for the values Crunch expects: expense types, VAT types, payment methods, countries, open accounting periods, and directors and employees.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_list_accounting_periods`](#crunch_list_accounting_periods) | 🟢 read | List open accounting periods |
| [`crunch_list_countries`](#crunch_list_countries) | 🟢 read | List countries |
| [`crunch_list_expense_types`](#crunch_list_expense_types) | 🟢 read | List expense types |
| [`crunch_list_payment_methods`](#crunch_list_payment_methods) | 🟢 read | List payment methods |
| [`crunch_list_persons`](#crunch_list_persons) | 🟢 read | List directors and employees |
| [`crunch_list_vat_types`](#crunch_list_vat_types) | 🟢 read | List VAT types |

### crunch_list_accounting_periods

🟢 read

List the open accounting periods (financial years) with their start and end dates and status. Expenses can only be created or changed in an open period; closed years can't be edited.

_No arguments._

### crunch_list_countries

🟢 read

List the countries Crunch knows, with the country codes to use in addresses and supplier records, and whether each is an EU member.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter |

### crunch_list_expense_types

🟢 read

List the expense types (categories) Crunch accepts in expenseType fields, for example ACCOUNTANCY, TELEPHONE or TRAVEL_AND_SUBSISTENCE, grouped as in Crunch, with each type's default VAT type. Use the `name` values when creating expenses and suppliers.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string |  | Types valid on this date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today) |
| `include_deprecated` | boolean |  | Include deprecated types (default false) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the API response unchanged |
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter on names and groups |

### crunch_list_payment_methods

🟢 read

List payment methods (for example EFT, CASH, DIRECTORS_EXPENSES) for recording expense payments or invoice payments. Use `name` as the payment method.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | string |  | For invoices: the payment direction as Crunch names it (default INCOMING, money received from customers) |
| `for` | `"expenses"` \| `"invoices"` |  | Expense payments (default) or invoice (customer) payments |

### crunch_list_persons

🟢 read

List the people (directors and employees) linked to the business on a date. Use their IDs as the person for DIRECTORS_EXPENSES payments and as the employee on expense lines.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string |  | Date the people were in post (YYYY-MM-DD; default today) |
| `role` | string |  | Only people with this role, as Crunch names it (for example DIRECTOR) |

### crunch_list_vat_types

🟢 read

List the VAT types (rates) Crunch accepts, with their percentages. Expenses and invoices have separate lists; use the names exactly as shown (for example "Standard", "Exempt", "Outside the Scope"), not code-style values.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `for` | `"expenses"` \| `"invoices"` \| `"both"` |  | Which list: expenses, invoices or both (default both) |

### crunch_archive_bank_account

🟠 write

Archive a bank account you no longer use (it stays in your records but is hidden), or restore an archived one with archive=false.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `archive` | boolean |  | true to archive (default), false to restore |

### crunch_archive_credit_card

🟠 write

Archive a credit card you no longer use, or restore an archived one with archive=false.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |
| `archive` | boolean |  | true to archive (default), false to restore |

### crunch_create_bank_account

🟠 write

Add a bank account to Crunch so payments can be recorded against it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_name` | string | yes | Bank, for example Starling |
| `display_name` | string | yes | Name shown in Crunch, for example Business Current Account |
| `account_name` | string |  | Name on the account |
| `account_number` | string |  | Account number |
| `bic` | string |  | BIC |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `iban` | string |  | IBAN |
| `personal` | boolean |  | A personal (not business) account used for business payments |
| `sort_code` | string |  | Sort code, for example 12-34-56 |

### crunch_create_credit_card

🟠 write

Add a credit card to Crunch so expenses can be paid from it. Set its opening balance with crunch_set_credit_card_opening_balance.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | string | yes | Name shown in Crunch, for example Amex Business |
| `card_number` | string |  | Card number (Crunch usually only needs the last four digits) |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `personal` | boolean |  | A personal card used for business payments |

### crunch_delete_bank_account

🔴 delete · destructive

Permanently delete a bank account. Only possible when nothing is recorded against it (see `deletable` in crunch_get_bank_account); archive it otherwise.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |

### crunch_delete_credit_card

🔴 delete · destructive

Permanently delete a credit card. Only possible when nothing is recorded against it; archive it otherwise.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |

### crunch_get_bank_account

🟢 read

Get one bank account in full: balance, account details, bank feed, unmatched statement entries and whether it can be edited, archived or deleted.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |

### crunch_get_credit_card

🟢 read

Get one credit card in full, including its opening balance.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |

### crunch_get_opening_balances

🟢 read

Get the opening balances of bank accounts or credit cards, and whether each can still be edited.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_ids` | integer[] | yes | Bank account or credit card IDs |
| `type` | `"bank_accounts"` \| `"credit_cards"` |  | Account type: bank_accounts (default) or credit_cards |

### crunch_list_bank_account_payments

🟢 read

List payments recorded in Crunch against a bank account (supplier payments, customer payments, transfers, salaries, dividends, tax payments...), either reconciled with the bank statement or still unreconciled. Paged; newest first by default.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `reconciled` | boolean | yes | true for payments matched to bank statement entries, false for those still waiting to be reconciled |
| `all` | boolean |  | Fetch every page (up to max_items) instead of a single page |
| `max_items` | integer |  | With all=true, stop after this many results (default 1000) |
| `page` | integer |  | Page to fetch, starting at 0 (default 0) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `size` | integer |  | Results per page, up to 200 (default 50) |
| `sort` | string |  | Sort order as field,asc or field,desc, for example postingDate,desc |

### crunch_list_bank_accounts

🟢 read

List the business's bank accounts with their current balance, sort code and account number, default flag, bank feed state and how many statement entries still need matching. Use the IDs when recording payments.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter on names and numbers |
| `status` | `"active"` \| `"archived"` \| `"all"` |  | Which to list: active (default), archived or all |

### crunch_list_credit_cards

🟢 read

List the business's credit cards with their balances, default flag and unmatched statement entries.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter on names and numbers |
| `status` | `"active"` \| `"archived"` \| `"all"` |  | Which to list: active (default), archived or all |

### crunch_set_credit_card_opening_balance

🟠 write

Set a credit card's opening balance (the amount owed when you started using Crunch for it). Creates it, or updates an existing editable one.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |
| `opening_balance` | number \| string | yes | Opening balance, for example 250.00 |

### crunch_set_default_bank_account

🟠 write

Make a bank account the default one, used for new invoices and payments.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |

### crunch_set_default_credit_card

🟠 write

Make a credit card the default one.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |

### crunch_update_bank_account

🟠 write

Change a bank account's details. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are kept. Sort code and account number can't be changed once the account has a bank feed or reconciled entries.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bank_account_id` | integer | yes | Bank account ID (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `account_name` | string |  | Name on the account |
| `account_number` | string |  | Account number |
| `bank_name` | string |  | Bank, for example Starling |
| `bic` | string |  | BIC |
| `display_name` | string |  | Name shown in Crunch, for example Business Current Account |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `iban` | string |  | IBAN |
| `personal` | boolean |  | A personal (not business) account used for business payments |
| `sort_code` | string |  | Sort code, for example 12-34-56 |

### crunch_update_credit_card

🟠 write

Change a credit card's details. Only the fields you pass change.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_card_id` | integer | yes | Credit card ID (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |
| `card_number` | string |  | Card number (Crunch usually only needs the last four digits) |
| `display_name` | string |  | Name shown in Crunch, for example Amex Business |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `personal` | boolean |  | A personal card used for business payments |

## clients

Clients (the customers you invoice): list, look up, create, update and delete.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_create_client`](#crunch_create_client) | 🟠 write | Create client |
| [`crunch_delete_client`](#crunch_delete_client) | 🔴 delete | Delete client |
| [`crunch_get_client`](#crunch_get_client) | 🟢 read | Get client |
| [`crunch_list_clients`](#crunch_list_clients) | 🟢 read | List clients |
| [`crunch_update_client`](#crunch_update_client) | 🟠 write | Update client |

### crunch_create_client

🟠 write

Create a client (customer) to invoice. A name and a billing address with line1, line2 and country are needed. Check crunch_list_clients first to avoid duplicates.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `billing_address` | object | yes | Billing address |
| `billing_address.country` | string | yes | Country code, for example GB (see crunch_list_countries) |
| `billing_address.line1` | string | yes | First line of the address |
| `billing_address.line2` | string | yes | Second line (the town or city if the address is short); Crunch requires it |
| `billing_address.line3` | string |  | Third line |
| `billing_address.line4` | string |  | Fourth line |
| `billing_address.post_code` | string |  | Postcode |
| `name` | string | yes | Customer name, for example Example Customer Ltd |
| `email` | string |  | Email address invoices are sent to |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `note` | string |  | Internal note about the customer |
| `payment_terms_days` | integer |  | Default payment terms in days, for example 30 |

### crunch_delete_client

🔴 delete · destructive

Delete a client (customer). Crunch refuses if the client has invoices.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | integer | yes | Client (customer) ID (see crunch_list_clients) |

### crunch_get_client

🟢 read

Get a client (customer) in full: contact details, billing address, payment terms and note.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | integer | yes | Client (customer) ID (see crunch_list_clients) |

### crunch_list_clients

🟢 read

List the business's clients (the customers you invoice) with email, payment terms and billing address. Use the IDs as the customer on invoices.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum number of results |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter on name, email and postcode |

### crunch_update_client

🟠 write

Change a client's details. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are kept (a new billing_address replaces the whole address).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | integer | yes | Client (customer) ID (see crunch_list_clients) |
| `billing_address` | object |  | New billing address (replaces the whole address) |
| `billing_address.country` | string | yes | Country code, for example GB (see crunch_list_countries) |
| `billing_address.line1` | string | yes | First line of the address |
| `billing_address.line2` | string | yes | Second line (the town or city if the address is short); Crunch requires it |
| `billing_address.line3` | string |  | Third line |
| `billing_address.line4` | string |  | Fourth line |
| `billing_address.post_code` | string |  | Postcode |
| `email` | string |  | Email address invoices are sent to |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `name` | string |  | New name |
| `note` | string |  | Internal note about the customer |
| `payment_terms_days` | integer |  | Default payment terms in days, for example 30 |

## suppliers

Suppliers (who you buy from): list, look up, create, update, archive and delete.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_create_supplier`](#crunch_create_supplier) | 🟠 write | Create supplier |
| [`crunch_delete_supplier`](#crunch_delete_supplier) | 🔴 delete | Delete supplier |

### crunch_create_supplier

🟠 write

Create a supplier. Only company_name is required; a default expense_type makes new expenses for this supplier quicker. Check crunch_list_suppliers first to avoid duplicates.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_name` | string | yes | Supplier name, for example Example Supplier Ltd |
| `contact_name` | string |  | Contact at the supplier |
| `country` | string |  | Country code, for example GB (see crunch_list_countries) |
| `expense_type` | string |  | Default expense type for this supplier's expenses, for example TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `vat_registration_number` | string |  | The supplier's VAT number |

### crunch_delete_supplier

🔴 delete · destructive

Delete a supplier. Only possible when it has no expenses (see `deletable`); archive it with crunch_update_supplier otherwise.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supplier_id` | integer | yes | Supplier ID (see crunch_list_suppliers) |

### crunch_get_supplier

🟢 read

Get a supplier in full.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supplier_id` | integer | yes | Supplier ID (see crunch_list_suppliers) |

### crunch_list_suppliers

🟢 read

List suppliers (who you buy from), with their default expense type, country and VAT number. `search` matches part of a name; `name` asks Crunch for an exact company name. Use the IDs when creating expenses.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_archived` | boolean |  | Include archived suppliers (default false) |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum number of results |
| `name` | string |  | Exact company name to look up |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `search` | string |  | Case-insensitive substring filter on name, contact and VAT number |

### crunch_update_supplier

🟠 write

Change a supplier's details, or archive/restore it. Only the fields you pass change.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supplier_id` | integer | yes | Supplier ID (see crunch_list_suppliers) |
| `archived` | boolean |  | Archive (true) or restore (false) the supplier |
| `company_name` | string |  | New name |
| `contact_name` | string |  | Contact at the supplier |
| `country` | string |  | Country code, for example GB (see crunch_list_countries) |
| `expense_type` | string |  | Default expense type for this supplier's expenses, for example TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw fields for the request body, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `vat_registration_number` | string |  | The supplier's VAT number |

| [`crunch_update_expense`](#crunch_update_expense) | 🟠 write | Update expense |

### crunch_add_expense_attachment

🟠 write

Attach one or more files (receipts, invoices) to an existing expense. Existing attachments are kept.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachments` | object[] | yes | Files to attach |
| `attachments[].file_name` | string | yes | File name including its extension, for example receipt.jpg |
| `attachments[].content_base64` | string |  | The file as base64, or as a data URI (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) |
| `attachments[].file_path` | string |  | Instead of content_base64: path to a file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR (absolute, or relative to it). Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |
| `attachments[].mime_type` | string |  | MIME type, for example image/jpeg (guessed from the file name when omitted) |
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |

### crunch_add_expense_payment

🟠 write

Record that an expense was paid (fully or partly): date, amount, payment method and the bank account, credit card or director it was paid from. Existing payments are kept.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number \| string | yes | Amount paid, for example 120.00 |
| `date` | string | yes | Payment date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account the payment went through (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `credit_card_id` | integer |  | Credit card the payment was made with (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |
| `payment_method` | string |  | Payment method name, for example EFT, CASH or DIRECTORS_EXPENSES (default EFT; see crunch_list_payment_methods) |
| `person_id` | integer |  | For DIRECTORS_EXPENSES: the director who paid (see crunch_list_persons) |

### crunch_create_expense

🟠 write

Record an expense: who it was from, the date, one or more lines (expense type, VAT type, gross amount), and optionally how it was paid and the receipt. Look up valid values first: crunch_list_expense_types, crunch_list_vat_types, crunch_list_payment_methods, crunch_list_bank_accounts. The date must be in an open accounting period.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `line_items` | object[] | yes | One or more lines, each with its own expense type, VAT type and amount |
| `line_items[].expense_type` | string | yes | Expense type name, for example ACCOUNTANCY or TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `line_items[].gross_amount` | number \| string | yes | Total including VAT, for example 120.00 |
| `line_items[].description` | string |  | What was bought |
| `line_items[].employee_id` | integer |  | Director or employee the line relates to (see crunch_list_persons) |
| `line_items[].net_amount` | number \| string |  | Amount before VAT (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_amount` | number \| string |  | VAT amount (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_type` | string |  | VAT type display name, for example Standard, Exempt or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types). Defaults to the expense type's default VAT type. |
| `posting_date` | string | yes | Date of the expense or receipt (YYYY-MM-DD); must be in an open accounting period |
| `attachments` | object[] |  | Receipts or invoices to attach |
| `attachments[].file_name` | string | yes | File name including its extension, for example receipt.jpg |
| `attachments[].content_base64` | string |  | The file as base64, or as a data URI (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) |
| `attachments[].file_path` | string |  | Instead of content_base64: path to a file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR (absolute, or relative to it). Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |
| `attachments[].mime_type` | string |  | MIME type, for example image/jpeg (guessed from the file name when omitted) |
| `create_supplier` | boolean |  | With supplier_name: create the supplier if it doesn't exist yet (default false) |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw ExpenseDto fields, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `note` | string |  | Internal note |
| `payments` | object[] |  | How it was paid; leave out to record it as unpaid |
| `payments[].amount` | number \| string | yes | Amount paid, for example 120.00 |
| `payments[].date` | string | yes | Payment date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `payments[].bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account the payment went through (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `payments[].credit_card_id` | integer |  | Credit card the payment was made with (see crunch_list_credit_cards) |
| `payments[].payment_method` | string |  | Payment method name, for example EFT, CASH or DIRECTORS_EXPENSES (default EFT; see crunch_list_payment_methods) |
| `payments[].person_id` | integer |  | For DIRECTORS_EXPENSES: the director who paid (see crunch_list_persons) |
| `supplier_id` | integer |  | Supplier ID (see crunch_list_suppliers). Give this or supplier_name. |
| `supplier_name` | string |  | Instead of supplier_id: the supplier's exact name |
| `supplier_reference` | string |  | The supplier's invoice or receipt number |

### crunch_delete_expense

🔴 delete · destructive

Permanently delete an expense with its lines, payments and attachments. Not possible for reconciled expenses or those in a closed year.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |

### crunch_download_expense_attachment

🟢 read

Download a receipt or other file attached to an expense. Images are returned so you can read them; other files (PDFs) come back as an embedded resource. Attachment IDs and names come from crunch_get_expense.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment_id` | integer | yes | Attachment ID within the expense (0, 1, 2...; see crunch_get_expense) |
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `file_name` | string |  | Attachment file name (looked up when omitted) |
| `save_to` | string |  | Also save the file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR: a directory (the file keeps its name) or a file path, absolute or relative to it. Existing files are never overwritten. Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |

### crunch_get_expense

🟢 read

Get one expense: its lines (types, VAT, amounts), payments, attachments, credit notes, and whether it can still be edited or deleted. raw=true returns the API object.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the API object unchanged (the base for hand-made updates) |

### crunch_get_expenses_total

🟢 read

Total the expenses matching the filters (gross amount, plus under- and over-paid amounts) without listing them. Handy for "how much did I spend on travel this year?".

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | yes | Expense status to total, as Crunch names it in the status field of expenses (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `end_date` | string |  | Expenses dated on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `expense_type` | string |  | Only this expense type, for example TRAVEL_AND_SUBSISTENCE |
| `has_attachment` | boolean |  | Only expenses with (true) or without (false) a receipt attached |
| `payment_end_date` | string |  | Paid on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `payment_method` | string |  | Only expenses paid this way, for example EFT |
| `payment_start_date` | string |  | Paid on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date` | string |  | Expenses dated on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `supplier_id` | integer |  | Only this supplier's expenses |

### crunch_list_expenses

🟢 read

List expenses (purchases, receipts and bills), newest first, filtered by supplier, expense type, date, payment date, payment method or whether a receipt is attached. Each result shows supplier, amounts, status, outstanding balance and payment method. Paged (up to 200 per page); use all=true to fetch every page.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean |  | Fetch every page (up to max_items) instead of a single page |
| `end_date` | string |  | Expenses dated on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `expense_type` | string |  | Only this expense type, for example TRAVEL_AND_SUBSISTENCE |
| `has_attachment` | boolean |  | Only expenses with (true) or without (false) a receipt attached |
| `max_items` | integer |  | With all=true, stop after this many results (default 1000) |
| `page` | integer |  | Page to fetch, starting at 0 (default 0) |
| `payment_end_date` | string |  | Paid on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `payment_method` | string |  | Only expenses paid this way, for example EFT |
| `payment_start_date` | string |  | Paid on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `size` | integer |  | Results per page, up to 200 (default 50) |
| `sort` | string |  | Sort order as field,asc or field,desc, for example postingDate,desc |
| `start_date` | string |  | Expenses dated on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `supplier_id` | integer |  | Only this supplier's expenses |

### crunch_remove_expense_payment

🔴 delete · destructive

Remove a payment from an expense, leaving the expense itself (it becomes unpaid or part-paid). Reconciled payments can't be removed. See crunch_get_expense for payment IDs.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `payment_id` | integer |  | Payment to remove; omit to remove all of the expense's payments |

### crunch_update_expense

🟠 write

Change an expense. The current expense is fetched and only what you pass changes: posting_date, supplier, reference, note, or line_items (which replace all lines). Payments and attachments are kept as they are; use crunch_add_expense_payment, crunch_remove_expense_payment and crunch_add_expense_attachment for those. Reconciled expenses and closed years can't be changed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expense_id` | integer | yes | Expense ID (see crunch_list_expenses) |
| `changes` | object |  | Raw ExpenseDto fields to merge into the current expense (advanced) |
| `line_items` | object[] |  | Replacement lines (all existing lines are replaced) |
| `line_items[].expense_type` | string | yes | Expense type name, for example ACCOUNTANCY or TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `line_items[].gross_amount` | number \| string | yes | Total including VAT, for example 120.00 |
| `line_items[].description` | string |  | What was bought |
| `line_items[].employee_id` | integer |  | Director or employee the line relates to (see crunch_list_persons) |
| `line_items[].net_amount` | number \| string |  | Amount before VAT (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_amount` | number \| string |  | VAT amount (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_type` | string |  | VAT type display name, for example Standard, Exempt or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types). Defaults to the expense type's default VAT type. |
| `note` | string |  | New internal note |
| `posting_date` | string |  | New date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `supplier_id` | integer |  | Move the expense to this supplier |
| `supplier_reference` | string |  | New supplier reference |

## recurring

Recurring expenses that Crunch creates on a schedule: list, create, pause or change, delete.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_create_recurring_expense`](#crunch_create_recurring_expense) | 🟠 write | Create recurring expense |
| [`crunch_delete_recurring_expense`](#crunch_delete_recurring_expense) | 🔴 delete | Delete recurring expense |
| [`crunch_get_recurring_expense`](#crunch_get_recurring_expense) | 🟢 read | Get recurring expense |
| [`crunch_list_recurring_expenses`](#crunch_list_recurring_expenses) | 🟢 read | List recurring expenses |
| [`crunch_update_recurring_expense`](#crunch_update_recurring_expense) | 🟠 write | Update recurring expense |

### crunch_create_recurring_expense

🟠 write

Set up a recurring expense: a template expense (supplier, lines, optional payment method) that Crunch creates automatically on a schedule. Schedule values are Crunch's own; look at an existing one with crunch_get_recurring_expense if you're unsure of the names.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `line_items` | object[] | yes | One or more lines, each with its own expense type, VAT type and amount |
| `line_items[].expense_type` | string | yes | Expense type name, for example ACCOUNTANCY or TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `line_items[].gross_amount` | number \| string | yes | Total including VAT, for example 120.00 |
| `line_items[].description` | string |  | What was bought |
| `line_items[].employee_id` | integer |  | Director or employee the line relates to (see crunch_list_persons) |
| `line_items[].net_amount` | number \| string |  | Amount before VAT (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_amount` | number \| string |  | VAT amount (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_type` | string |  | VAT type display name, for example Standard, Exempt or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types). Defaults to the expense type's default VAT type. |
| `recurrence` | object | yes | The schedule |
| `recurrence.frequency` | string | yes | How often, as Crunch names it in recurringEventFrequency (for example MONTHLY); check an existing recurring expense if unsure |
| `recurrence.next_occurrence_date` | string | yes | Date of the next (first) expense to create (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `recurrence.description` | string |  | Description of the schedule |
| `recurrence.enabled` | boolean |  | Whether the schedule is active (default true) |
| `recurrence.end_date` | string |  | Last date, when it ends on a date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `recurrence.end_type` | string |  | How the schedule ends, as Crunch names it in recurringEventEndType (never, on a date, or after a number of occurrences) |
| `recurrence.frequency_occurrence` | string |  | Crunch's frequencyOccurrence setting, if your schedule needs it |
| `recurrence.occurrence_count` | integer |  | Number of expenses to create, when it ends after a count |
| `bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account the payments come from |
| `create_supplier` | boolean |  | With supplier_name: create the supplier if it doesn't exist yet (default false) |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw ExpenseDto fields, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `note` | string |  | Internal note |
| `payment_method` | string |  | Payment method for the created expenses, for example EFT |
| `posting_date` | string |  | Date on the template expense (defaults to the first occurrence) |
| `supplier_id` | integer |  | Supplier ID (see crunch_list_suppliers). Give this or supplier_name. |
| `supplier_name` | string |  | Instead of supplier_id: the supplier's exact name |
| `supplier_reference` | string |  | The supplier's invoice or receipt number |

### crunch_delete_recurring_expense

🔴 delete · destructive

Delete a recurring expense so no more expenses are created from it. Expenses it already created are kept. To pause it instead, use crunch_update_recurring_expense with enabled=false.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recurring_expense_id` | integer | yes | Recurring expense ID (see crunch_list_recurring_expenses) |

### crunch_get_recurring_expense

🟢 read

Get a recurring expense in full: the template expense (supplier, lines, payment) and its schedule (recurringEvent).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recurring_expense_id` | integer | yes | Recurring expense ID (see crunch_list_recurring_expenses) |

### crunch_list_recurring_expenses

🟢 read

List recurring expenses (regular bills such as rent, phone or software subscriptions that Crunch creates automatically) with supplier, amount, status and next date.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean |  | Fetch every page (up to max_items) instead of a single page |
| `max_items` | integer |  | With all=true, stop after this many results (default 1000) |
| `page` | integer |  | Page to fetch, starting at 0 (default 0) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `size` | integer |  | Results per page, up to 200 (default 50) |
| `sort` | string |  | Sort order as field,asc or field,desc, for example postingDate,desc |

### crunch_update_recurring_expense

🟠 write

Change a recurring expense: its lines, its schedule (for example pause it with enabled=false, or change the next or end date), or any field via `changes`. Only what you pass changes. Expenses already created aren't affected.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recurring_expense_id` | integer | yes | Recurring expense ID (see crunch_list_recurring_expenses) |
| `changes` | object |  | Raw ExpenseDto fields to merge in, for example {"recurringEvent": {"recurringEventFrequency": "..."}} (advanced) |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Pause (false) or resume (true) the schedule |
| `end_date` | string |  | New end date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `line_items` | object[] |  | Replacement lines (all existing lines are replaced) |
| `line_items[].expense_type` | string | yes | Expense type name, for example ACCOUNTANCY or TELEPHONE (see crunch_list_expense_types) |
| `line_items[].gross_amount` | number \| string | yes | Total including VAT, for example 120.00 |
| `line_items[].description` | string |  | What was bought |
| `line_items[].employee_id` | integer |  | Director or employee the line relates to (see crunch_list_persons) |
| `line_items[].net_amount` | number \| string |  | Amount before VAT (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_amount` | number \| string |  | VAT amount (normally worked out by Crunch from the VAT type) |
| `line_items[].vat_type` | string |  | VAT type display name, for example Standard, Exempt or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types). Defaults to the expense type's default VAT type. |
| `next_occurrence_date` | string |  | New next date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `note` | string |  | New internal note |
| `supplier_reference` | string |  | New supplier reference |

Sales invoices: list and filter, totals, create drafts, update, issue, email to the customer, record and remove payments, attachments, PDF download, delete.

| [`crunch_delete_invoice`](#crunch_delete_invoice) | 🔴 delete | Delete invoice |
| [`crunch_download_invoice_attachment`](#crunch_download_invoice_attachment) | 🟢 read | Download invoice attachment |
| [`crunch_download_invoice_pdf`](#crunch_download_invoice_pdf) | 🟢 read | Download invoice PDF |
| [`crunch_email_invoice`](#crunch_email_invoice) | 🟣 email | Email invoice to customer |
| [`crunch_get_default_invoice_note`](#crunch_get_default_invoice_note) | 🟢 read | Get default invoice note |
| [`crunch_get_invoice`](#crunch_get_invoice) | 🟢 read | Get invoice |
| [`crunch_get_invoice_status`](#crunch_get_invoice_status) | 🟢 read | Get invoice status |
| [`crunch_get_invoice_totals`](#crunch_get_invoice_totals) | 🟢 read | Get invoice totals |
| [`crunch_issue_invoice`](#crunch_issue_invoice) | 🟠 write | Issue invoice |
| [`crunch_list_invoices`](#crunch_list_invoices) | 🟢 read | List invoices |
| [`crunch_remove_invoice_payment`](#crunch_remove_invoice_payment) | 🔴 delete | Remove invoice payment |
| [`crunch_update_invoice`](#crunch_update_invoice) | 🟠 write | Update invoice |

### crunch_add_invoice_attachment

🟠 write

Attach files (for example timesheets) to a sales invoice. Existing attachments are kept; an invoice can have up to 5.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachments` | object[] | yes | Files to attach (an invoice can have up to 5) |
| `attachments[].file_name` | string | yes | File name including its extension, for example receipt.jpg |
| `attachments[].content_base64` | string |  | The file as base64, or as a data URI (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) |
| `attachments[].file_path` | string |  | Instead of content_base64: path to a file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR (absolute, or relative to it). Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |
| `attachments[].mime_type` | string |  | MIME type, for example image/jpeg (guessed from the file name when omitted) |
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |

### crunch_add_invoice_payment

🟠 write

Record a payment received from a customer against an issued invoice (full or part payment). This records the payment but doesn't reconcile the matching bank statement entry. Existing payments are kept.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number \| string | yes | Amount received, for example 120.00 |
| `date` | string | yes | Date the customer paid (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account the money went into (defaults to the invoice's bank account) |
| `payment_method` | string |  | Payment method name (default EFT; see crunch_list_payment_methods for=invoices) |

### crunch_create_invoice

🟠 write

Create a draft sales invoice for a client: date, lines (description, unit price excluding VAT, quantity, VAT rate), payment terms and the bank account to be paid into. Crunch's API only supports GBP. The invoice stays a draft until crunch_issue_invoice. Look up the client (crunch_list_clients), VAT rates (crunch_list_vat_types for=invoices) and bank account first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | integer | yes | Customer to invoice (see crunch_list_clients; create one with crunch_create_client) |
| `issued_date` | string | yes | Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `items` | object[] | yes | Invoice lines |
| `items[].description` | string | yes | What was sold, for example Consulting services |
| `items[].price_excl_vat` | number \| string | yes | Unit price before VAT, for example 100.00 |
| `items[].vat_rate` | string | yes | VAT type display name, for example Standard or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types for=invoices) |
| `items[].line_type` | string |  | Crunch's lineType (default S) |
| `items[].quantity` | number \| string |  | Quantity (default 1) |
| `attachments` | object[] |  | Up to 5 files to attach |
| `attachments[].file_name` | string | yes | File name including its extension, for example receipt.jpg |
| `attachments[].content_base64` | string |  | The file as base64, or as a data URI (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) |
| `attachments[].file_path` | string |  | Instead of content_base64: path to a file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR (absolute, or relative to it). Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |
| `attachments[].mime_type` | string |  | MIME type, for example image/jpeg (guessed from the file name when omitted) |
| `bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account the customer should pay into, shown on the invoice (see crunch_list_bank_accounts) |
| `due_date` | string |  | Due date (YYYY-MM-DD); worked out from the payment terms when omitted |
| `extra` | object |  | Additional raw SalesInvoiceDto fields, using Crunch's own field names (advanced). Merged last. |
| `line_item_type` | `"SIMPLE"` \| `"DETAILED"` |  | SIMPLE (default) or DETAILED lines |
| `note` | string |  | Note printed on the invoice (see crunch_get_default_invoice_note) |
| `payment_terms_days` | integer |  | Payment terms in days, for example 28 |
| `purchase_order` | string |  | The customer's purchase order number |
| `reference` | string |  | Your reference |
| `send_reminders` | boolean |  | Have Crunch email the customer payment reminders (true needs CRUNCH_ALLOW_EMAIL=true) |

### crunch_delete_invoice

🔴 delete · destructive

Delete a sales invoice. Usually only drafts can be deleted (see `deletable` in crunch_get_invoice); issued invoices are corrected with credit notes in Crunch.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices); not the invoice number |

### crunch_download_invoice_attachment

🟢 read

Download a file attached to a sales invoice. Attachment IDs and names come from crunch_get_invoice.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment_id` | integer | yes | Attachment ID within the invoice (see crunch_get_invoice) |
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `file_name` | string |  | Attachment file name (looked up when omitted) |
| `save_to` | string |  | Also save the file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR: a directory (the file keeps its name) or a file path, absolute or relative to it. Existing files are never overwritten. Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |

### crunch_download_invoice_pdf

🟢 read

Download a sales invoice as a PDF, as Crunch renders it for the customer. Returned as an embedded resource; use save_to to also write it to disk (when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `save_to` | string |  | Also save the file in the server's CRUNCH_FILES_DIR: a directory (the file keeps its name) or a file path, absolute or relative to it. Existing files are never overwritten. Only works when the server sets CRUNCH_FILES_DIR |

### crunch_email_invoice

🟣 email

Email an issued sales invoice (as a PDF) to the customer from Crunch. This sends a real email: confirm the recipients, subject and message with the user first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `email_addresses` | string[] |  | Recipients (default: the customer's email address) |
| `include_attachments` | boolean |  | Also send the invoice's attachments (default false) |
| `message` | string |  | Email message |
| `subject` | string |  | Email subject |

### crunch_get_default_invoice_note

🟢 read

Get the default note Crunch prints on new sales invoices (often payment instructions).

_No arguments._

### crunch_get_invoice

🟢 read

Get one sales invoice: customer, dates, lines, VAT, payments received, credit notes, attachments and status. raw=true returns the API object.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices); not the invoice number |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the API object unchanged |

### crunch_get_invoice_status

🟢 read

Get an invoice's current state (status, number, amounts, outstanding balance, due date), which is lighter than crunch_get_invoice.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices); not the invoice number |

### crunch_get_invoice_totals

🟢 read

Get sales invoice totals: with no filters, everything invoiced and still outstanding; with filters (client, status, issue or due dates, invoice number, recurring), the amount invoiced, owed to you and owed by you for the matching invoices.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | integer |  | Only this client's invoices |
| `due_from_date` | string |  | Due on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `due_to_date` | string |  | Due on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `invoice_number` | string |  | Only this invoice number |
| `issued_from_date` | string |  | Issued on or after (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `issued_to_date` | string |  | Issued on or before (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `recurring` | boolean |  | Only recurring (true) or one-off (false) invoices |
| `status` | string |  | Only invoices with this status, as Crunch names it |

### crunch_issue_invoice

🟠 write · destructive

Issue a draft sales invoice: it gets its invoice number and is posted to your accounts. This is final (correct mistakes afterwards with a credit note in Crunch). It does not email the customer; see crunch_email_invoice.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices); not the invoice number |

### crunch_list_invoices

🟢 read

List sales invoices, newest first: number, customer, dates, status, amounts and outstanding balance. Filter by client, or by status (which fetches every page and filters here). Paged (up to 200 per page); use all=true to fetch every page.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean |  | Fetch every page (up to max_items) instead of a single page |
| `client_id` | integer |  | Only this client's invoices (see crunch_list_clients) |
| `max_items` | integer |  | With all=true, stop after this many results (default 1000) |
| `page` | integer |  | Page to fetch, starting at 0 (default 0) |
| `raw` | boolean |  | Return the full objects from the API instead of compact summaries (larger) |
| `size` | integer |  | Results per page, up to 200 (default 50) |
| `sort` | string |  | Sort order as field,asc or field,desc, for example postingDate,desc |
| `status` | string |  | Only invoices with this status, as shown in the status field (for example DRAFT); fetches all pages and filters them here |

### crunch_remove_invoice_payment

🔴 delete · destructive

Remove a recorded customer payment from an invoice (for example one entered by mistake). Reconciled payments can't be removed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `payment_id` | integer | yes | Payment to remove (see crunch_get_invoice) |

### crunch_update_invoice

🟠 write

Change a sales invoice. The current invoice is fetched and only what you pass changes; existing payments and attachments are kept. `items` replaces all lines. Issued invoices may be restricted by Crunch.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoice_id` | integer | yes | Invoice ID (see crunch_list_invoices) |
| `bank_account_id` | integer |  | Bank account shown on the invoice |
| `changes` | object |  | Raw SalesInvoiceDto fields to merge into the current invoice (advanced) |
| `client_id` | integer |  | Move the invoice to this customer |
| `due_date` | string |  | New due date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `issued_date` | string |  | New invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `items` | object[] |  | Replacement lines (all existing lines are replaced) |
| `items[].description` | string | yes | What was sold, for example Consulting services |
| `items[].price_excl_vat` | number \| string | yes | Unit price before VAT, for example 100.00 |
| `items[].vat_rate` | string | yes | VAT type display name, for example Standard or Outside the Scope (see crunch_list_vat_types for=invoices) |
| `items[].line_type` | string |  | Crunch's lineType (default S) |
| `items[].quantity` | number \| string |  | Quantity (default 1) |
| `note` | string |  | New note printed on the invoice |
| `payment_terms_days` | integer |  | Payment terms in days |
| `purchase_order` | string |  | New purchase order number |
| `reference` | string |  | New reference |
| `send_reminders` | boolean |  | Have Crunch email the customer payment reminders (true needs CRUNCH_ALLOW_EMAIL=true) |

## raw

A raw API escape hatch for anything the other tools don't cover. It is limited to GET requests unless writes are enabled.

| Tool | Access | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`crunch_api_request`](#crunch_api_request) | 🟢 read | Raw Crunch API request |

### crunch_api_request

🟢 read · destructive

Call any Crunch public API endpoint directly, for anything the other tools don't cover. `path` is relative to the API root and starts with the service: /banking, /clients, /company-details, /expenses, /immutable-data, /invoices or /user-details. All HTTP methods are allowed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to https://public-api.crunch.co.uk/v1, starting with the service, for example /expenses/vat-types |
| `body` | any |  | JSON request body for POST and PUT |
| `method` | `"GET"` \| `"POST"` \| `"PUT"` \| `"DELETE"` |  | HTTP method: GET (default), POST, PUT or DELETE |
| `query` | object |  | Query string parameters |

## Prompts

Prompts are ready-made requests that tell the model which tools to call and what to report. In Claude Code they appear as slash commands, such as `/mcp__crunch__business_health_check`.

### business_health_check

A plain-English review of the business: cash in the bank, money owed to and by you, overdue invoices, unpaid bills and anything that needs attention.

### chase_overdue_invoices

Find overdue sales invoices and draft polite chasing emails for each customer.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `days_overdue` |  | Only invoices at least this many days overdue (default 1) |

### create_invoice

Raise a sales invoice for a client, checking the client, VAT rate, payment terms and bank account.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client` | yes | Who to invoice |
| `work` | yes | What to invoice for, with amounts or day rates |

### expense_review

Review a period's expenses for missing receipts, unpaid bills, odd categories and possible duplicates.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` |  | First day (YYYY-MM-DD; default three months ago) |
| `end_date` |  | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD; default today) |

### period_summary

Income, spending and cash summary for a month, quarter or year, for example to prepare for a VAT return or year end.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | yes | First day (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date` | yes | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD) |

### record_receipt

Turn a receipt, bill or description of a purchase into a correctly categorised Crunch expense.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `details` | yes | What was bought: supplier, date, amount, how it was paid (or attach the receipt image) |
